title: Nonperiodic and Nonquadratic FFT Schemes for Materials
exact_target: Extend Fourier-based material solvers to nonperiodic boundaries, nonquadratic energies and grain-boundary effects.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30005835 (OWR-14298167-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mechanics of Materials: Multiscale Design of Advanced Materials and Structures (2024), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2024/11, pp. 657--730. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: All three requested extensions are retained. Accuracy, stability and convergence need hypotheses for the actual selected material law.
